prompt: Two agents are both attempting to modify the same file in a repository. What is this type of conflict called, and how should it be resolved?
explanation: Correct answer: B) An overlapping code change conflict — resolved by configuring agent isolation and conflict detection

options.text: A memory collision — resolved by clearing agent memory
An overlapping code change conflict — resolved by configuring agent isolation and conflict detection
A tool misuse error — resolved by disabling file write tools
A context drift — resolved by resetting both agents
